contexts.text: Appear to themselves in crowns.
By representations they formed a golden crown studded with diamonds round His head.
Thy crowned are as the locusts (). AE 543:10.
Hence it is evident what is signified by the thorny crown. (See Thorn.)
A crown of adornment () = the wisdom which is of good. AC 9930:8.
A crown is a representative of Divine good. Illustrated.

That a crown represented Divine good from which is Divine truth, is evident from the crown of kings; for kings represent the Lord as to Divine truth; hence they had a crown on the head, and a sceptre in the hand; for government from Divine good was represented by a crown, and from Divine truth by a sceptre. Illustrated.

Crown () = Divine good from which is wisdom; from which also is His government. The crown which is wisdom is said to flourish, by that which He acquired for Himself in the world through combats and victories.
A crown of ornament () = the wisdom which is of good. AC 9930:8.
A crown upon the head () = wisdom thence. AC 10. AE 577:3.

As the good of wisdom is acquired through combats of temptations, which are effected through the truths of faith, they who fought against evils and falsities, and conquered, received crowns: hence the martyrs' crowns: they were the insignia of command by the Lord over evils. Crowns = rewards of victory over evils, and that therefore they = goods of wisdom, because these are the rewards. Illustrated.
A golden crown () = Divine good from which is Divine truth.
A crown () = good from truths; thus wisdom; for this is of the good of love from the truths of faith.
A crown of ornament () = spiritual good, which is the good of truth; a crown = good; and beauty, what is spiritual.
A crown () = eternal life, the reward of victory.
The locusts having crowns () = that they appeared to themselves as conquerors. AR 432. AE 553.
As various jewels give beauty in a king's crown.
These varieties (in the Church) may be compared to the various jewels in a king's crown. AR 73. TCR 763:end.

I will give thee the crown of life () = that they will then have eternal life, the reward of victory... As the martyrs desired it, after death crowns were given them, by which was signified the reward of victory: they still appear in their crowns in Heaven. ( = wisdom. AE 126.).

That no one take thy crown () = lest wisdom perish, from which comes eternal happiness... The reason a crown = wisdom, is that wisdom holds the highest place with man, and thus crowns him: nor does a king's crown signify anything else; for a king = Divine truth, from which comes all wisdom. AE 218.
Wisdom is signified by a crown. Illustrated.
A crown of adornment () = wisdom from Divine truth, or from the Word. AE 126:3. AE 195:7. AE 272:8.
They had on their heads golden crowns () = the things which are of wisdom from love. A crown = wisdom. ( = Divine good. AE 272.)
They cast their crowns before the throne () = acknowledgement that their wisdom is from Him alone. AE 292.

A crown was given to him () = an ensign of his combat. The reason a crown = a badge of combat, is that in ancient times kings wore crowns in battle. Illustrated. And as temptations are spiritual combats, which the martyrs endured, crowns were given them as ensigns of victory. AE 358.
On her head a crown of twelve stars () = wisdom and intelligence from the Knowledges of Divine good and Divine truth from the Word. A crown on the head = wisdom and intelligence. AE 709.
A golden crown () = wisdom from love; and as it was seen on the head of the Son of Man, by a golden crown is signified Divine wisdom from His Divine love.
The bride wore a crown of gold set with rubies.
[155a] 4. The dove had a crown as of gold on its head. CL 293:end.
This is the crown of her honour.
Virginity is the crown of chastity. Explained.
In place of a king's crown, they set on His head a crown of thorns.
This New Church is the crown of all the Churches. General article. TCR 787. TCR 789:end, Signified.

The reason a crown = wisdom, is that all things which invest and distinguish man derive their signification from that part of the man which they invest or distinguish: a crown, therefore, = wisdom, because it is a distinction for the head, by which is signified wisdom, because it resides there. Illustrated.
The crown of our head has fallen () = wisdom (has done so). 272 7.
That crowns = good, and thence wisdom; and that truths are what are crowned. Illustrated. AE 292.
Upon himself shall his crown flourish () = Divine good from which is Divine wisdom, and from which is His government. ( = perpetual victory over evils. AE 684:29.)
In that day shall Jehovah of Armies be for a crown of adornment () = wisdom which is of good from the Divine.

Jerusalem = the Church which is in truths from good; hence it is called a crown of ornament in the hand of Jehovah ()... A crown of ornament = the wisdom which is of good... and on account of this signification, it is said to be in the hand of Jehovah.
The adornment of your head shall come down, the crown of your ornament () = the wisdom which is of good. Ornament = the Divine truth of the Church.
The crown (on the head of the rider on the white horse, ), being predicated of the Lord, = Divine good, which He put on even as to the Human, as the reward of victory.
The golden crown (on the head of the Son of Man, ) = Divine good from which is Divine truth.
That a crown = Divine good from which is Divine truth, was represented by the plate of gold which was on the face of the mitre worn by Aaron, which plate is also called a crown, and a coronet (; ).
A crown of the best gold () = good from which are these (truths from good)... The crown of kings = Divine good.
Where temptations are treated of, a crown = (eternal life the reward of victory), as in .

As the wars in the Word = combats against evils and falsities, and kings = truths from good which fight against them; when they were in the knowledge of correspondences, kings in battle had a crown on the head and a bracelet on the arm (). A crown in battle was an ensign of combat.
The glorying of intelligence or learning is signified by the crown of pride (). AE 734:15.
The crown (on the woman's head, ) = their good.
Having on His head a golden crown () = Divine good girded for judgment. Explained.
As now we have one God in the Church, Who is God Man and Man God, this Church is called the crown of all the Churches.
